fact: Airtel Niger officially launched commercial sale of 'Starlink by Airtel' on 16 January 2026 in Niamey, offering Starlink V4 enterprise and V3 High Performance connectivity to state services, NGOs, projects and businesses; the document says it was already operational with some clients.

ARCEP Niger stated in a communique that Starlink-fed 'Wifi Zones' reselling connectivity operate without the required prior authorisation (law 2018-45) and ordered them to stop or regularise by 3 October 2025, with controls and sanctions after; the document is dated 2025-09-09 and gives no other date.

NINETEC, an authorised Starlink distributor, officially launched distribution of Starlink kits in Niger (NINE-Starlink campaign) on 30 April 2025, chaired by the communications minister; the ARCEP director general said kits may be sold only to identified end users and resale or sharing is prohibited.

Niger's communications ministry announced Starlink commercial availability (residential and corporate kits online and via authorised sellers), and Starlink said service was operational, following a November 2024 agreement with the government; the document gives the launch as March 2025, its published date.
Niger's government signed a partnership agreement with SpaceX on 29 October 2024 authorising it to deploy Starlink services across the territory.

The communications minister announced Starlink internet services available in Niger from 13 March 2025, with residential and business kits sold online and via authorised sellers, for the customer's own personal or professional use.

Per Niger's Ministry of Communications, Starlink launched in Niger and kits for residential and corporate use are available for purchase, following a November 2024 agreement with the military government; kit sharing is prohibited (date is the article's published date, none given for the launch).
MyBroadband's Starlink status table lists Niger as 'Available' as of 17 July 2026.
TechnoMag lists Niger among the markets where Starlink is active as of mid-2026 (date is the article's published date).
Le360 lists Niger among 29 countries that have granted Starlink a licence as of May 2026; the grant date and licensing body are not given.
